visionPro.raw: Apple Newsroom, October 15, 2025 ('Apple Vision Pro upgraded with the M5 chip and Dual Knit Band'): "Customers can pre-order Apple Vision Pro with the M5 chip and Dual Knit Band today in Australia, Canada, France, Germany, Hong Kong, Japan, the UAE, the UK, and the U.S." "It will be available for pre-order in China mainland and Singapore on Friday, October 17." "Apple Vision Pro with the M5 chip and Dual Knit Band will be available in Apple Store locations in Australia, Canada, China mainland, Hong Kong, France, Germany, Japan, Singapore, the UAE, the UK, and the U.S. on Wednesday, October 22." "It will be available in South Korea and Taiwan later." Derived market list: Australia, Canada, China mainland, France, Germany, Hong Kong, Japan, Singapore, South Korea, Taiwan, UAE, UK, US (13).
visionPro.notes: Neither the shop page nor apple.com/vision-pro lists countries; the latest official Apple list found is the October 15, 2025 newsroom post. No 2026 Apple newsroom post with an updated country list was found (2026 Vision Pro posts are software/content only). South Korea and Taiwan were stated as 'later' in that post.
